recommendation: J5 has already passed the material-positive-share gate and retains very large front/profile safety margins. The remaining failures are only mean positive-bias magnitude gates. Configured regional caps are high enough in principle, but the effective beta delivered to the biased populations is reduced by front-core/shell mask overlap. Do not relax any gate and do not alter X08 support. Design a more selective residual corrector that increases effective beta only on non-front slow-TOF/tail nodes while leaving accepted front nodes locked.
